description: This file defines a class 'Language' within the Opencart Admin Controller Event namespace, which handles events related to language management such as adding language tasks, template processing, and maintaining language data during controller execution.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class handling language-related events in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Adds a 'language' task to the system's task list, triggered after language-related CRUD operations.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Populates the provided args array with all language variables for template rendering.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Stores current language data into a backup before executing other controller actions.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Restores language data from backup after controller actions have completed.
